seo.description: Giancarlos Garza builds high-performance interfaces, offline-first platforms and design systems with Vue, Nuxt and TypeScript.
seo.ogTitle: Giancarlos Garza · Front-End Engineer & UI/UX Designer
seo.ogDescription: High-performance interfaces, offline-first platforms and design systems built with Vue, Nuxt and TypeScript.

p01.description: A web color suite and design platform with client-side color algorithms, real-time contrast tools and its own published npm libraries for UI and CSS.

p02.description: A high-throughput kiosk platform with offline-first architecture, multi-tenant support and shift-based access, built for fast operation on touch screens.

p03.description: A live telematics application that renders vehicle locations and operational status on maps, refreshing continuously while the browser stays responsive.

p04.description: An SSR platform for caterers and hospitality teams with real-time quote generation, booking workflows and responsive layouts for office and on-site work.

p05.tagline: Healthcare operations & clinical ERP web app
p05.description: A healthcare management platform for medical clinics covering patient records, clinical scheduling, automated service-charge billing and multi-tier financial approval workflows.

performance.title: Performance as a feature
performance.text: Speed gets planned from the first commit. Lean SSR, performance budgets and Core Web Vitals guide every build decision.

systems.title: Systems over screens
systems.text: Tokens, libraries and reusable patterns replace one-off pages, so products stay consistent and cheap to evolve.

designInCode.title: Design in code
designInCode.text: UI/UX decisions live where they ship: semantic HTML, real states and motion in the browser instead of static mockups.
